metadata.description: Partial crosswalk transcribed from BetterGov's FY2027 congressional HTML analysis and joined to its 20th Congress roster. NOT an authoritative DEO service-area boundary dataset or project attribution table.
metadata.completeness: incomplete; original HTML emphasizes multi-link relationships and omits many one-to-one relationships
metadata.relationshipMeaning: A row in an undated source allocation table linked an office label and a legislative district label. This does not establish exact geographic jurisdiction, project location, legislative sponsorship, or any FY2027 amount.

source.underlyingDocument: DPWH per district.pdf (scan mentioned in HTML; document not independently examined)

warnings: Representative names come from a repository roster, not an independent current membership check.
Taguig 1st, Taguig 2nd and General Santos City Lone did not strictly match roster labels; unresolved representatives are null.
The original HTML displays zero-valued amount rows as a dash. Those are represented as null source amounts, not numeric zero allocations.
BARMM is a grouped jurisdiction label, not an individual District Engineering Office.
